data.define: Describes things that are corny or too sweet.

misuse.text: Don't call her poem 'cheesy' at the party.
misuse.why: It sounds mean about heartfelt effort.

data.l1_hook: Thư tình của ổng còn có vần nữa. Ghê!

native.tip: “cheesy” = Sến súa. Ví dụ: “That movie was so cheesy.”
native.caption:
“cheesy” nghĩa là gì?
“cheesy” = Sến súa.
Ví dụ: “That movie was so cheesy.” (Phim đó cheesy kinh khủng.)
